sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: An epiphytic cactus from southern Mexico, adapted to seasonally dry forest. Its flattened, wavy stems are about 10–70 cm long and 5–7 cm wide.

sections.title: Flowering and fruit
sections.text: It bears large red flowers on the flattened stems, followed by fruit. Cultivated plants form trailing clumps about 20–40 cm tall.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The taxonomic and horticultural sources consulted do not report established food use; this does not establish that its fruit is edible.
